fusions.name: Parting Current
fusions.desc: Looses 2 jets of water that split apart, each dealing 7 damage with a 50% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 8 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Twin Tines
fusions.desc: Strikes twice with both points, dealing 26 damage that ignores armour and leaving the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Halved Burden
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 6 health.

fusions.name: The Other Path
fusions.desc: Once every 120 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
